headline: NBET Finance Lists Landmark N728.98bn Bonds on FMDQ Exchange
summary: FMDQ Securities Exchange approved the listing of NBET Finance Company's landmark bond issuance, including a N402 billion 7-year fixed rate series.
why: Large-scale corporate and agency bond listings expand domestic debt capital markets and provide long-term funding instruments for infrastructure and energy sectors.

impacts.name: NBET Finance Company Plc
impacts.why: Listing large bond tranches expands the company's capital market presence.
